y-m-54-05.title: Kulungile yini ukuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngo-x?
y-m-54-05.topic: Umbandela wokuhlola ngaphambi kokuphindaphinda ngokuguquguqukayo ekungalinganini okungxenyana
y-m-54-05.goal: Yakha wena isibonelo esiphikisayo sesiphetho x<3 esitholwe ngokuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ze-6/x>2 ngo-x, bese ubhala kabusha isixazululo ukubonisa ukuthi isiqondiso sophawu lokungalingani sincike ophawini lika-x.
y-m-54-05.material: UJiho ubhale lokhu ngenkathi exazulula ukungalingani 6/x > 2 (x iyinombolo yangempela engeyona u-0). "Uma ngiphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngo-x, 6 > 2x, ngakho x < 3. Ngakho x=-1 nayo iyisixazululo." 6/x ifundwa '6 phezu kuka-x.'
y-m-54-05.prereq.0: Lo msebenzi ucabanga ukwabelwa kobunzima (H2) 'kwendlela ye-Basic Math 1 yesikole samabanga aphezulu' futhi ayikhombisi ukuthi okuqukethwe kufundwa kuliphi ibanga (izilungiselelo zesikole ziyahluka). Ukungalingani okulayini kwezinga lesikole sesibili (ukuphindaphinda ngenombolo enegethivu kuphendulela uphawu lokungalingani) nokubala amanani ezibalo ezingxenyana.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.prompt: Sifuna ukuhlola ukuthi isiphetho sikaJiho 'uma x<3 khona-ke 6/x>2' silungile yini. Khetha into yokuqala efanele ukwenziwa.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa amanani ane-x<3 abe yiphozithivu nanegethivu, bese ukhetha amabili noma amathathu kuyo yonke.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.hint.1: Faka inani ngalinye ku-6/x bese uhlela etafuleni ukuthi likhulu noma lincane kuno-2.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.a: Phindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngo-2 bese ubona ukuthi izibalo ziyalingana yini
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.a: Isibalo esisha esenziwe ngokuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngenombolo efanayo asihlobene ngqo nokuthi isiphetho sokuqala silungile noma siphutha.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.b: Faka x=3 bese ubona ukuthi izinhlangothi ezimbili ziyalingana yini
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.b: Ukuhlola inani lomkhawulo kuphela akuhloli wonke x<3.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.c: Hlukanisa u-6/x ngo-x ukwenza isibalo sibe lula
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.c: Lokho kwenza nje isibalo sibe nzima kakhulu futhi akuyona isenzo sokuhlola isiphetho.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.d: Faka amanani ambalwa ane-x<3 ekungalinganini kokuqala
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.d: Le yindlela ehlola ngqo ezinye zamacala isiphetho esikhuluma ngawo.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.explain: Isitatimende 'uma x<3 sihlala sibamba' siphulwa uma ngisho nenani elilodwa ne-x<3 lingenzi ukungalingani kubambe. Ukufaka ngqo ekungalinganini kokuqala 6/x>2 kuyindlela eqondile kakhulu.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.prompt: Faka izinombolo ezigcwele ezi-2 ezahlukile x lapho isiphetho sikaJiho x<3 sibamba kodwa ukungalingani kokuqala 6/x>2 kungabambi. (x iyinombolo ephelele kusukela ku--50 kuya ku-50, futhi x ayiyona u-0)
y-m-54-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka inombolo ephelele eyodwa enegethivu neyodwa eyiphozithivu ene-x<3 ku-6/x.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi u-6/x mkhulu kuno-2 kanye nophawu lwayo.

y-m-54-05.s.s2.fail.c1: x kufanele ibe yinombolo ephelele engeyona u-0 kusukela ku--50 kuya ku-50.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.ok.c3: 6/x ingu-2 noma ngaphansi, ngakho ukungalingani kokuqala akubambi.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.fail.c3: 6/x inkulu kuno-2, ngakho ukungalingani kokuqala kuyabamba. Akuyona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.explain: Uma x=-1, khona-ke 6/x=-6, futhi -6 ayinkulu kuno-2. Noma ne-x<3 kunamanani lapho kungabambi khona, ngakho isiphetho sikaJiho asilungile. Wonke lawa manani anegethivu.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.prompt: Lungisa isixazululo sikaJiho. Bhala ndawonye lapho inkinga yayikhona nebanga lesixazululo esitholwe kahle.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ngokwehlukana isibalo oyithola ngokuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngo-x uma x iyiphozithivu nalapho inegethivu.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi x=-1 ifakiwe yini uma uhlanganisa imiphumela yamacala amabili.

y-m-54-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe unqume isiqondiso sophawu lokungalingani ngokwehlukana kucala ngalinye?
y-m-54-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uhlolile ukuthi ibanga lesixazululo sakho alifaki x=-1, uJiho ayiphutha?
y-m-54-05.s.s3.model.0: Inkinga ukuthi uphindaphinde ngo-x ngaphandle kokwazi uphawu lika-x. Uma x inegethivu, isiqondiso sophawu lokungalingani siyaphenduka. Kuphela uma x>0 iba ngu-6>2x, ngakho isixazululo ngu-0<x<3.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.model.1: Uma x>0, khona-ke 6>2x, ngakho 0<x<3. Uma x<0, uphawu lokungalingani luyaphenduka lube ngu-6<2x, okungukuthi x>3, kodwa lokho akuhlangani no-x<0, ngakho akukho sixazululo. Ngakho isixazululo ngu-0<x<3.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Yabala futhi icala elinegethivu ngokwehlukana yakhombisa ukuthi akukho sixazululo.

y-m-54-03.title: Uma sishintsha k, izixazululo zishintsha kanjani?
y-m-54-03.topic: Inani lezimpande zangempela zesibalo se-quadratic x²-4x+k=0, ne-k enika izimpande ezingamanani aphelele
y-m-54-03.goal: Bheka ukuthi inani lezimpande zangempela zesibalo se-quadratic esiqukethe inhlamvu k lishintsha kanjani ngo-k, yenza wena amanani ka-k anika izimpande ezimbili ezahlukile ezingamanani aphelele, bese uchaza umthetho.
y-m-54-03.material: Esibalweni x²-4x+k=0, k iyinombolo ephelele, futhi izixazululo zicatshangelwa phakathi kwezinombolo zangempela. Uma ushintsha k, inani nesimo sezixazululo kuyashintsha. USubin unqume ukuthola izixazululo ngenkathi eshintsha k abe ngu-0, 3, 4, 5, -1. x²-4x+k ifundwa 'x ngesikwele kususwe 4x kwengeziwe k.'
y-m-54-03.thinking.0: Ukufaka amanani ku-k nokuqhathanisa inani lezimpande
y-m-54-03.prereq.0: Lo msebenzi ucabanga ukwabelwa kobunzima (H2) 'kwendlela ye-Basic Math 1 yesikole samabanga aphezulu' futhi ayikhombisi ukuthi okuqukethwe kufundwa kuliphi ibanga (izilungiselelo zesikole ziyahluka). Ukuxazulula izibalo ze-quadratic zezinga lesikole sesibili (ukuhlukanisa izici, ifomula ye-quadratic) nencazelo yezinombolo zesikwele (1, 4, 9, 16, ...).
y-m-54-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha wonke ama-k lapho kunezixazululo ezimbili zangempela ezahlukile. (k isigaba esingaguquki sesibalo esingenhla)
y-m-54-03.s.s1.hint.0: Faka k elilodwa ngelilodwa bese ubhala kabusha isibalo ngefomu (x-2)² = (inombolo ethile).
y-m-54-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuthi zingaki izixazululo uma inombolo ngakwesokudla iyiphozithivu, ingu-0, nalapho inegethivu.
y-m-54-03.s.s1.r.a: Lena indlela ehlola ngokuxazulula ngqo ukuthi kuphuma izixazululo ezimbili ezahlukile yini.
y-m-54-03.s.s1.r.d: Lena indlela ehlola ngokuxazulula ngqo ukuthi kuphuma izixazululo ezimbili ezahlukile yini.
y-m-54-03.s.s1.r.b: Kungenzeka ubale icala elinesixazululo esisodwa kuphela (isixazululo esiphindwayo) njengezixazululo ezimbili ezahlukile. Zama ukuhlukanisa u-x²-4x+4 ube yizici.
y-m-54-03.s.s1.r.c: Kungenzeka ucabange ukuthi uma k ikhula, izixazululo ziba zinengi. Esibalweni x²-4x+5=0, bheka ukuthi (x-2)² kufanele kube yinani luni.
y-m-54-03.s.s1.r.e: Awuphuthelwanga iqiniso lokuthi k enegethivu nayo ingaba nezixazululo.
y-m-54-03.s.s1.explain: Njengoba x²-4x+k=(x-2)²+k-4, sithola (x-2)²=4-k. Uma 4-k>0, okungukuthi k<4, kunezixazululo ezimbili ezahlukile; uma k=4 kunesixazululo esisodwa; futhi uma k>4 akukho zixazululo zangempela.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.prompt: Faka izinombolo ezigcwele ezi-3 k lapho x²-4x+k=0 inezinombolo ezimbili ezigcwele ezahlukile njengezixazululo zayo. (k iyinombolo ephelele engu--60 noma ngaphezulu, futhi izixazululo ziyizinombolo ezimbili ezigcwele ezahlukile phakathi kwezinombolo zangempela)
y-m-54-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bheka ama-coefficient ka-x²-4x bese ucabanga ukuthi isamba sezixazululo ezimbili kufanele sibe ngu-muni.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha izinombolo ezimbili ezigcwele ezinaleso samba, uzithathe njengezixazululo ezimbili, bese ubala ukuthi k iba yini.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.ok.c1: k iyinombolo ephelele engu--60 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.fail.c1: k kufanele ibe yinombolo ephelele engu--60 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Lelo yibanga lapho kunezixazululo ezimbili zangempela ezahlukile.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Uma k ingu-4 noma ngaphezulu, azivami izixazululo ezimbili ezahlukile.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Izixazululo ezimbili ziphuma njengezinombolo ezigcwele ezinembile.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Izixazululo aziyizinombolo ezigcwele. Thola isimo sezixazululo ngqo bese uhlola.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.explain: Uma k=0, izixazululo ngu-0, 4. Uma k=3, 1, 3. Uma k=-5, -1, 5. Uma k=-12, -2, 6. Kuzo zonke isamba sezixazululo singu-4 futhi umphumela ungu-k. Kuzinombolo ezigcwele k=1, 2, izixazululo aziyizinombolo ezigcwele.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Ama-k owathole alandela umthetho muni? Bhala nokuthi, ngesibonelo esisodwa senombolo okungenani, kungani k=1 noma k=2 ingasebenzi.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala izixazululo ezimbili ezitholwe ku-k=0, 3, -5 eceleni komunye nomunye bese uqhathanisa isamba nomphumela wezixazululo ezimbili.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi izixazululo ze-x²-4x+1=0, ezenziwe uma k=1, ziyizinombolo ezigcwele yini.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umthetho engiwunikeze uchaza zonke izibonelo ezi-3 ku-s2?
y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe umthetho ungahlunga amacala angasebenzi, njengo-k=1?
y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usebenzise umthetho ukubikezela elinye k elisha futhi walihlola?
y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Isamba sezixazululo ezimbili kufanele sihlale singu-4. Uma ukhetha izinombolo ezimbili ezigcwele ezinesamba esingu-4, k iba umphumela wazo. Isibonelo, nge-1 no-3, k=3, futhi nge--1 no-5, k=-5. Uma k=1, umphumela ungu-1, futhi azikho izinombolo ezigcwele ezinesamba esingu-4.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.model.1: 16-4k kufanele ibe yinombolo yesikwele enkulu kuno-0 ukuze izimpande ziphume njengezinombolo ezigcwele. Ku-k=3 ngu-4, ku-k=0 ngu-16, futhi ku-k=-5 ngu-36, zonke izinombolo zesikwele. Ku-k=1 ngu-12, okungeyona inombolo yesikwele, ngakho ayisebenzi.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Le yenye indlela echaza ngokuthi inani elibaliwe liyinombolo yesikwele yini esikhundleni sesamba nomphumela.

y-m-54-02.title: Ukuhlukanisa kukaHarin: kuhlala kulungile?
y-m-54-02.topic: Inani lezixazululo zesibalo esimaqondana esinenhlamvu ku-coefficient
y-m-54-02.goal: Funda ukuthi inani lezixazululo zesibalo esifana no-(a-2)x=b-3 lishintsha ngo-a no-b, nquma ukuthi yini odinga ukuyazi ngaphambi kokusho isixazululo, bese wenza a no-b abafanelana nezimo wena.
y-m-54-02.material: Kunesibalo (a-2)x = b-3 ku-x. a no-b yizinombolo (ezingaguquki) amanani azo angakanqunywa. UHarin uthe, “Uma uhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-a-2, uthola x=(b-3)/(a-2), ngakho njalo kunesixazululo esisodwa,” futhi uUjin uthe, “Kungashintsha kuye ngo-a.” (a-2)x ifundwa 'a minus 2, times x.'
y-m-54-02.prereq.0: Lo msebenzi ucabanga ukwabiwa kobunzima (H2) 'kwendlela ye-Basic Math 1 yesikole esiphakeme' futhi akukhombisi ukuthi okuqukethwe kufundwa ebangeni liphi (izilungiselelo zesikole ziyahluka). Ukuxazulula kwezinga lesikole esiphakathi kwezibalo ezimaqondana neqiniso lokuthi 'awukwazi ukuhlukanisa ngo-0.'
y-m-54-02.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukusho isixazululo salesi sibalo njengenani elilodwa ngaphandle kokwazi amanani ka-a no-b. Khetha into efaneleke kakhulu okufanele uyazi kakhulu.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.hint.0: Faka amanani afana no-3 no-2 ku-a oyedwa ngesikhathi bese ubhala ukuthi isibalo sishintsha kanjani.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kuyadingeka yini isimo ngenombolo lapho uhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngenombolo efanayo.

y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.a: Uma usetha b=3 uhlangothi lwesokudla luba ngu-0, kodwa isiphetho siyashintsha futhi kuye ngokuthi i-coefficient ngakwesobunxele ingu-0 yini.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.b: Sidinga ukwazi ukuthi a-2 ingu-0 noma cha
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.b: Ubona ukuthi isimo senombolo ohlukanisa ngayo singahlukanisa isiphetho.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.c: Kwanele ukwazi kuphela ukuthi a no-b kokubili kuyizinombolo ezigcwele
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.c: Isici sokuba yinombolo ephelele asithinti inani lezixazululo. Uma a=2, iyinombolo ephelele nayo.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.d: Kwanele ukwazi kuphela ukuthi x iyiphozithivu yini
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.d: Ukwazi uphawu lwa-x kukude kakhulu nolwazi lokuhlukanisa inani lezixazululo. Bheka uhlangothi lwe-coefficient.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.explain: Uma i-coefficient a-2 ka-x ingeyona u-0, ungahlukanisa futhi kunesixazululo esisodwa. Uma a-2=0, isibalo siba ngu-0·x=b-3, futhi uma b-3 ingu-0 kunezixazululo ezingenakubalwa, kungenjalo akukho sixazululo. Ngakho udinga ukwazi ukuthi a-2 ingu-0 yini.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.prompt: Nquma izinombolo ezigcwele a no-b ukuze isibalo (a-2)x = b-3 singabi nasixazululo nhlobo, bese ufaka izibonelo ezi-2 ezahlukile. (a no-b kuyizinombolo ezigcwele kusukela ku--20 kuya ku-20)
y-m-54-02.s.s2.hint.0: Faka u-2 ku-a ukwenza uhlangothi lwesobunxele lube lula, bese ubheka ukuthi linika inani elifanayo noma yimuphi u-x ofakwayo.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlukanisa icala lapho uhlangothi lwesokudla b-3 lungu-0 nelicala lapho lungeyona u-0, bese ufaka inani elilodwa lika-x ngqo.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Uma i-coefficient a-2 ka-x ingeyona u-0, kunesixazululo esisodwa.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.ok.c3: 0·x ilingana nenombolo engeyona u-0, ngakho akukho sixazululo.

y-m-54-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala impendulo ezothunyelwa kuHarin. Bhala ukuthi ngelipi icala 'kuhlala kunesixazululo esisodwa' kukaHarin kungabambi nokuthi kwenzekani esixazululweni kuleli cala.

y-m-54-02.s.s3.model.0: Uma a ingu-2, khona-ke a-2 ingu-0, ngakho awukwazi ukuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngayo. Khona-ke iba ngu-0·x=b-3, ngakho uma b ingeyona u-3 akukho sixazululo, futhi uma b ingu-3 wonke u-x uyisixazululo. Kuphela uma a ingeyona u-2 kunesixazululo esisodwa, x=(b-3)/(a-2).
y-m-54-02.s.s3.model.1: Ngaphambi kokuhlukanisa, kufanele sihlole ukuthi a=2 yini. Uma a=2 uzobe uhlukanisa ngo-0, okungavunyelwe, futhi uma b=3 kunezixazululo ezingenakubalwa futhi uma b ingeyona u-3 akukho sixazululo. Uma a ingeyona u-2, kunesixazululo esisodwa njengoba uHarin ethe.
y-m-54-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kuhluke kuphela ukulandelana kokuhlukanisa amacala, futhi okuqukethwe kuyafana.

y-m-54-01.s.s1.explain: Kunezinkinga emugqeni 2 nomugqa 4, futhi isisho esiphumayo emugqeni 3 nasona asilungile ngenxa yazo. Umugqa 2: isikwele asisetshenziswa ngokwehlukana ezinkathini ezimbili ezibhrakhethini; ku-(x+3)(x+3), zonke izibini (x·x, x·3, 3·x, 3·3) ziyavela. Umugqa 4: ngoba nje x=0 isebenza, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi isebenza kuwo wonke u-x. Isibonelo, uma x=1, uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-16 futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla lungu-10. (Ukukhetha noma yimuphi emigqeni 2, 3, noma 4 kuyamukelwa njengokuthola umugqa ongalungile.)
y-m-54-01.s.s2.prompt: Thola futhi ufake amabhanqa ama-3 ahlukene ezinombolo eziphelele (a, b) lapho (a+b)² = a²+b² ibamba ngempela. Isimo: a no-b ziyizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-−9 kuya ku-9. (Ibhanqa elinezindawo ze-a no-b ezishintshisiwe libalwa njengesibonelo esifanayo.)

y-m-54-04.title: Kungani elilodwa lamanani amabili lingesona isixazululo?
y-m-54-04.topic: Ukuhlola amanani atholwe uma kuxazululwa isibalo esinamanani aphelele
y-m-54-04.goal: Thola lapho isiqagelo esithi 'wonke amanani aphuma ekuxazululweni ayizixazululo' siphuka khona esixazululweni se-|x-1|=2x, bese uchaza ngendlela yakho ukuthi kungani isixazululo esisodwa kuphela esisala.
y-m-54-04.material: USeoa uxazulule isibalo |x-1| = 2x. x iyinombolo yangempela. |x-1| ifundwa 'inani eliphelele lika-x kususwe 1.' Isixazululo sikaSeoa singezansi.
y-m-54-04.prereq.0: Lo msebenzi ucabanga ukwabelwa kobunzima (H2) 'kwendlela ye-Basic Math 1 yesikole samabanga aphezulu' futhi ayikhombisi ukuthi okuqukethwe kufundwa kuliphi ibanga (izilungiselelo zesikole ziyahluka). Incazelo yenani eliphelele (ibanga kusuka ku-0 emugqeni wezinombolo, lihlala lingu-0 noma ngaphezulu) nokuxazulula izibalo ezilayini zezinga lesikole sesibili.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa ophutha esixazululweni sikaSeoa. (Imigqa ibalwa kusukela ku-1.)
y-m-54-04.s.s1.hint.0: Xazulula futhi imigqa 1 kuya ku-3 ukuhlola ukubala ngakunye, bese ubheka ukuthi yisiphi isitatimende esisha esenziwa emigqeni elandelayo.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.hint.1: Faka amanani amabili elilodwa ngelilodwa esibalweni sokuqala |x-1|=2x bese ubala izinhlangothi zombili.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.line.4: Lawa ngamanani amabili atholwe ngokuxazulula, ngakho womabili ayizixazululo zalesi sibalo.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 4 no-5. Enqubweni yokuxazulula, akukho siqinisekiso sokuthi izixazululo zezibalo ezivela emacaleni ahlukanisiwe ziyizixazululo zesibalo sokuqala. Uma ufaka x=-1 esibalweni sokuqala, uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-|-2|=2 futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla lungu-2×(-1)=-2, ezihlukile. Kwa-x=1/3, uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-2/3 futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla lungu-2/3, ezifanayo.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.prompt: Uma ufaka x=-1 esibalweni sokuqala, uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-|-1-1|=2 futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla lungu-2×(-1)=-2. Khetha okufaneleke kakhulu ukukusho kusukela kulo mphumela.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi liyini inani elincane kakhulu uhlangothi lwesobunxele |x-1| olungaba nalo.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bala ukuthi isibalo singabamba yini ebangeni lika-x lapho uhlangothi lwesokudla 2x lunegethivu.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.a: |x-1| ingu-0 noma ngaphezulu kodwa 2x inegethivu, ngakho ayifaneli
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu ukucabanga okuqala ngokubheka ibanga lamanani uhlangothi olulodwa lwesibalo olungaba nawo.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.b: Ngenxa yenani eliphelele, izinombolo ezinezimpawu ezihlukile zingabonwa njengenombolo efanayo, ngakho lesi naso siyisixazululo
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.b: Inani eliphelele lisusa uphawu kuphela ohlangothini lwesobunxele. Alinamthelela ohlangothini lwesokudla 2x.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.c: Bekukhona iphutha lokubala, futhi uma uxazulula futhi wonke amanani womabili ayizixazululo
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.c: Uma ulibiza ngokuthi iphutha noma ukubala okufakiwe kulungile, kungenzeka awuwethembi umphumela owuhloliwe.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.d: x=-1 isixazululo futhi x=1/3 asiyona isixazululo
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.d: Kungenzeka ukhethe eyodwa kuphela ngokulandelana ngaphandle kokufaka womabili amanani ukuhlola. Faka no-1/3 nawo.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.explain: |x-1| ihlala ingu-0 noma ngaphezulu, ngakho 2x nayo kufanele ibe ngu-0 noma ngaphezulu. Ku-x=-1, 2x inegethivu, ngakho ayifaneli, futhi ku-x=1/3 izinhlangothi zombili zingu-2/3. Ngakho isixazululo esisodwa kuphela ngu-x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.prompt: Esikhundleni sendlela kaSeoa, bhala enye indlela eyodwa ekhombisa ukuthi x=1/3 kuphela isixazululo. Isibonelo: nquma ibanga lika-x kuqala, noma uhlukanise ube x≥1 no-x<1. Bhala nokuthi kungani x=-1 ingesona isixazululo.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.hint.0: Faka x=-1 ezinhlangothini zombili zesibalo sokuqala bese uqhathanisa izimpawu.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi inani eliphelele lingaba namaphi okungenani, bese ubhala ukuthi yimuphi umbandela ofakwe esibalweni sesokudla.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ungachaza ukuthi indlela yami ibeka kuphi 'isizathu sokuhlunga isixazululo' ngokuhlukile endleleni kaSeoa?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlolile ngokufaka esibalweni sokuqala ukuthi x=1/3 ngempela isixazululo?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Isizathu sokulahla u-x=-1 sicacile, noma ngebanga noma ngokufaka?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.model.0: |x-1| ingu-0 noma ngaphezulu, ngakho 2x kufanele ibe ngu-0 noma ngaphezulu, ngakho x≥0. Khona-ke x=-1 iyalahlwa futhi ku-x=1/3 kuphela kusala. Uma ufaka u-1/3, izinhlangothi zombili zilingana no-2/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.model.1: Uma x≥1, x-1=2x inika x=-1, kodwa lokho akuyona x≥1, ngakho ayisebenzi. Uma x<1, 1-x=2x inika x=1/3, ofeza x<1. Ngakho isixazululo esisodwa kuphela ngu-x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Yafinyelela esiphethweni esifanayo ngendlela yokuhlukanisa ibanga.

y-m-54-09.topic: Ukuqagela izixazululo zokungalingani f(x)<0 no-f(x)≤0 kusukela ethebuleni nemibandela yomsebenzi we-quadratic
y-m-54-09.goal: Uma kunethebula lamanani omsebenzi kuphela, hlukanisa lokho okungashiwo ngokuqinisekile mayelana nalapho f(x)<0, bese ulandela ukuthi isixazululo sinqunywa kanjani njengoba ulwazi lwanda nokuthi umehluko phakathi kwe-< ne-≤ ubonakala kanjani esixazululweni.
y-m-54-09.material: Kunomsebenzi we-quadratic f(x). I-coefficient ye-x² ku-f(x) inhle, ngakho igrafu inesimo se-U. Amanani e-f(x) avezwa isinyathelo nesinyathelo. f(-2) ifundwa 'f ka-negative 2.'
y-m-54-09.prereq.0: Lo msebenzi uthatha ukwabelwa kobunzima (H2) 'kwendlela yeBasic Math 1 yesikole esiphakeme' futhi akukhombisi ukuthi okuqukethwe kufundwa ebangeni liphi (izilungiselelo zezikole ziyahluka). Isimo somsebenzi we-quadratic y=ax²+bx+c (se-U uma a>0), ukubala amanani omsebenzi, nezisekelo zokuhlukanisa ngezici.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.prompt: Funda ulwazi olwaziwayo bese ukhetha isibikezelo mayelana no-x onelisa f(x)<0. Ungagcina noma ushintshe isibikezelo sangaphambilini.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula ukuthi inani ngalinye ethebuleni linhle, ngu-0, noma lingemuhle, bese uzwakalisa lapho isimo se-U sikhuphukela khona.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.hint.1: Njalo uma kufika ulwazi olusha, hlola futhi ukuthi lokho obukusho ngokuqinisekile ngaphambilini kusalungile yini.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yini ongayisho ngokuqinisekile manje mayelana no-x onelisa f(x)<0?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.after: f(0)=-3<0, ngakho u-x=0 ufakiwe ngokuqinisekile. Isimo siyi-U futhi f(-2) no-f(4) zinhle, ngakho u-x ongu-f(x)<0 angaba phakathi kuka--2 no-4 kuphela. Kodwa asikazi imingcele eyiyona. 'c' no-'d' kokubili ngamaqiniso ahlukile angashiwo ngokuqinisekile manje.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uthathe kuphela amaphoyinti lapho inani lahlolwa khona njengezixazululo. Asikazi amanani aphakathi kwamaphoyinti, kodwa singasebenzisa umumo we-U.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uphethe ngokuthi konke okungaphakathi kunegethivu ngokubona nje ukuthi amanani eziphethweni aphozithivu. Asikazi amanani aphakathi kuka-0 no--2.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Uma kukhona u-x anelisa u-f(x)<0, bonke baphakathi kuka--2 no-4
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Lokhu ukucabanga okusebenzisa umumo we-U nezimpawu zamanani eziphethweni ndawonye.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Kumumo we-U, u-f ungu-0 ku--1 no-3, ngakho unegethivu phakathi kwabo futhi uphozithivu ngaphandle. U-f(x)<0 usho 'ungaphansi kuka-0,' ngakho imikhawulo u--1 no-3 ayifakiwe, kunika u--1<x<3. Akuphikisani no-x=0, owathi wawuqinisekile esinyathelweni esedlule, ukuba phakathi kwalobu bubanzi.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ubheke isikhawu esinegethivu nesikhawu esiphozithivu somumo we-U ngokuphambene. Hlola ukuthi sihambisana no-f(0)=-3 yini.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Noma ubone ukuthi u-f ungu-0 emikhawulweni u--1 no-3, uwafake ngaphansi kwesimo esithi 'ngaphansi kuka-0.'
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uthathe kuphela amaphoyinti lapho u-f engu-0 njengezixazululo. Lawa maphoyinti awasiwo amanani angaphansi kuka-0.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.info: Isimo sishintshile. Lo msebenzi ngu-f(x)=x²-2x-3. (Ungahlola ngokubala ngqo ukuthi uhambisana nawo wonke amanani asethebuleni.) Manje umbuzo ungobubanzi buka-x lapho u-f(x)≤0, okungukuthi, 'ungu-0 noma ungaphansi.'
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.after: U-f(-1)=0 no-f(3)=0 nabo bangu-0 noma bangaphansi, ngakho imikhawulo ifakiwe, kunika u--1≤x≤3. Uma uphawu lokungalingani luguquka lusuka ku-< luye ku-≤, amanani omkhawulo angena esixazululweni.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Awuzange ubonise ukuthi u-≤ ufaka u-'ulingana.' Bheka ukuthi u-f(-1) no-f(3) bangu-yini.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ubona u-≤, wawushintsha waba izikhawu zangaphandle. Hlola ukuthi u-f(0)=-3 ungu-0 noma ungaphansi yini.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uthathe kuphela iphoyinti eliqinisekisiwe njengesixazululo. Amanani angaphakathi nawo wonke angu-0 noma angaphansi?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.reflect: Kusuka emanani ambalwa ethebuleni, ungahlukanisa 'lokho okuqinisekile (uphawu lwamanani omsebenzi, ububanzi obutholwe kumumo we-U)' no-'lokho okungakaziwa (imikhawulo eqondile),' futhi njengoba ulwazi lukhula, ububanzi obuqinisekile buyancipha.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.prompt: Lesi yisixazululo sikaSeungu esithole isixazululo sika-f(x)<0 uma u-f(x)=x²-2x-3. Khetha umugqa owodwa ophosile. (Imigqa ibalwa kusuka ku-1.)
y-m-54-09.s.s2.hint.0: Faka u-x=-3 emphumeleni womugqa 4, u-x<3, futhi ubale ukuthi ukungalingani kokuqala u-f(x)<0 kuyasebenza yini.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.hint.1: Hlela ethebuleni ukuthi yiziphi izinhlanganisela zezimpawu ezenza umkhiqizo ube negethivu.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.line.2: Umkhiqizo unegethivu, ngakho u-x+1<0 noma u-x-3<0.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.line.3: Ngakho u-x<-1 noma u-x<3, okungukuthi, u-x<3.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 3 (nomugqa 4, ovela kuwo) uyinkinga. Ukuze umkhiqizo ube negethivu, izimpawu zezici ezimbili kumele zihluke. Uma usho u-'okungenani oyedwa wabo unegethivu,' kufaka necala lapho zombili izici zinegethivu, futhi khona-ke umkhiqizo uphozithivu. Isibonelo, uma u-x=-3, u-(-2)(-6)=12, ophozithivu. Impendulo elungile ngu--1<x<3. (Ukukhetha noma umugqa 3 noma umugqa 4 kuyamukelwa njengokulungile.)
